title: Right tab stops are measured from the column edge (the indent only moves the text start); a left default stop past the edge wraps the tab instead of pinning it
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-28): A4 1080 margins (column 9746 twips), Arial 11, right dot-leader stop at 9746 under w:ind left 0/240/480: titles start 54.0/66.0/78.0, every page number's ink ends at 541.32 = 54 + 487.3 - bearing; control paragraph 54.0. Trailing-tab probe (render-tab-trailing-wrap): a left default stop past the edge wraps whether or not text follows the tab

cases.note: indent 0: the number's left edge is the stop minus its width (gen lands 1px short: the flush-right pin guard against Chromium's round-up)
indent 240: same landing, the indent moved only the title
a right stop inside the column lands exactly
the stop is parsed in column (twip) space next to the indent
L749 probe: the tenth trailing tab lands on 9360 twips, inside the 9990 column
a stop inside the column never wraps
